title: senecio sericeus var. glabriusculus
intro: Senecio sericeus var. glabriusculus, commonly known as the Silver-stemmed Cotton Bush or Bear's Breeches, is a variety of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Senecio sericeus var. glabriusculus include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful for relieving respiratory issues and soothing muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
